meta.name: hunt-apt
meta.description: Hunt for a specific APT/threat actor in your environment. Use when you have a threat actor name or GTI collection ID and want to search for their TTPs and IOCs. Gathers intelligence from GTI, searches SIEM for IOCs and TTP-based indicators, and documents findings.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并追踪特定APT组织在你的环境中的活动
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要根据威胁情报在SIEM中搜索入侵指标
copy.tagline_en: Search and track specific APT activity in your environment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search SIEM for IOCs based on threat actor intelligence

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，当你指定一个APT组织（如APT29）或GTI集合ID，Claude会自动搜集该组织的情报（TTP和IOC），在你的SIEM中搜索匹配的指标，并生成包含所有查询和发现的报告。
howto.when: 当你提供APT组织名称或GTI集合ID，并要求进行威胁狩猎时触发。

say.text: 针对APT29组织进行威胁狩猎。
say.note: Claude会获取APT29情报并搜索SIEM匹配项。
Claude会基于该集合ID展开调查。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, when you specify an APT group name or GTI collection ID, Claude automatically gathers intelligence (TTPs and IOCs) for that group, searches your SIEM for matching indicators, and generates a report documenting all queries and findings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an APT group name or GTI collection ID and ask to perform a threat hunt.

say_en.text: Conduct a threat hunt for APT29.
say_en.note: Claude gathers APT29 intel and searches SIEM for matches.
Claude investigates based on that collection ID.
